descricao_original: The central lumen of the seminal vesicle has been partitioned by primary, secondary and tertiary arches composed of the lining epithelium and its underlying lamina propria. The presence of a central lumen and the numerous, intersecting arches surrounding it help to distinguish the seminal vesicle from the ampulla of the oviduct. At the periphery of the gland is a layer of smooth muscle. 100x
